“Say of your brothers, ‘My people,’ and of your sisters, ‘My loved one.’
Say to your brothers, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ruhamah.
你們要稱你們的弟兄為阿米（就是我民的意思），稱你們的姊妹為路哈瑪（就是蒙憐憫的意思）。
Rebuke your mother, rebuke her, for she is not My wife, and I am not her husband. Let her remove the adultery from her face and the unfaithfulness from between her breasts.
Take up the cause against your mother, take it up, for she is not my wife, and I am not her husband; let her put away her loose ways from her face, and her false ways from between her breasts;
你們要與你們的母親大大爭辯；因為她不是我的妻子，我也不是她的丈夫。叫她除掉臉上的淫像和胸間的淫態，
Otherwise, I will strip her naked and expose her like the day of her birth. I will make her like a desert and turn her into a parched land, and I will let her die of thirst.
For fear that I may take away her robe from her, making her uncovered as in the day of her birth; making her like a waste place and a dry land, causing her death through need of water.
免得我剝她的衣服，使她赤體，與才生的時候一樣，使她如曠野，如乾旱之地，因渴而死。
I will have no compassion on her children, because they are the children of adultery.
And I will have no mercy on her children, for they are the children of her loose ways.
我必不憐憫她的兒女，因為他們是從淫亂而生的。
For their mother has played the harlot and has conceived them in disgrace. For she thought, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me bread and water, wool and linen, oil and drink.’

For their mother has been untrue; she who gave them birth has done things of shame, for she said, I will go after my lovers, who give me my bread and my water, my wool and my linen, my oil and my wine.
他們的母親行了淫亂，懷他們的母做了可羞恥的事，因為她說：我要隨從所愛的；我的餅、水、羊毛、麻、油、酒都是他們給的。
Therefore, behold, I will hedge up her path with thorns; I will enclose her with a wall, so she cannot find her way.
For this cause I will put thorns in her road, building up a wall round her so that she may not go on her way.
因此，我必用荊棘堵塞她的道，築牆擋住她，使她找不著路。
She will pursue her lovers but not catch them; she will seek them but not find them. Then she will say, ‘I will return to my first husband, for then I was better off than now.’

And if she goes after her lovers she will not overtake them; if she makes search for them she will not see them; then will she say, I will go back to my first husband, for then it was better for me than now.
她必追隨所愛的，卻追不上；她必尋找他們，卻尋不見，便說：我要歸回前夫，因我那時的光景比如今還好。
For she does not acknowledge that it was I who gave her grain, new wine, and oil, who lavished on her silver and gold— which they crafted for Baal.
For she had no knowledge that it was I who gave her the grain and the wine and the oil, increasing her silver and gold which they gave to the Baal.
她不知道是我給她五穀、新酒，和油，又加增她的金銀；她卻以此供奉（或譯：製造）巴力。
Therefore I will take back My grain in its time and My new wine in its season; I will take away My wool and linen, which were given to cover her nakedness.
So I will take away again my grain in its time and my wine, and I will take away my wool and my linen with which her body might have been covered.
因此到了收割的日子，出酒的時候，我必將我的五穀新酒收回，也必將她應當遮體的羊毛和麻奪回來。
And then I will expose her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and no one will deliver her out of My hands.
And now I will make her shame clear before the eyes of her lovers, and no one will take her out of my hand.
如今我必在她所愛的眼前顯露她的醜態；必無人能救她脫離我的手。
I will put an end to all her exultation: her feasts, New Moons, and Sabbaths— all her appointed feasts.
And I will put an end to all her joy, her feasts, her new moons, and her Sabbaths, and all her regular meetings.
我也必使她的宴樂、節期、月朔、安息日，並她的一切大會都止息了。
I will destroy her vines and fig trees, which she thinks are the wages paid by her lovers. So I will make them into a thicket, and the beasts of the field will devour them.

And I will make waste her vines and her fig-trees, of which she has said, These are the payments which my lovers have made to me; and I will make them a waste of trees, and the beasts of the field will take them for food.
我也必毀壞她的葡萄樹和無花果樹，就是她說「這是我所愛的給我為賞賜」的。我必使這些樹變為荒林，為田野的走獸所吃。
I will punish her for the days of the Baals when she burned incense to them, when she decked herself with rings and jewelry, and went after her lovers. But Me she forgot,” declares the LORD.

And I will give her punishment for the days of the Baals, to whom she has been burning perfumes, when she made herself fair with her nose-rings and her jewels, and went after her lovers, giving no thought to me, says the Lord.
我必追討她素日給諸巴力燒香的罪；那時她佩帶耳環和別樣妝飾，隨從她所愛的，卻忘記我。這是耶和華說的。
“Therefore, behold, I will allure her and lead her to the wilderness, and speak to her tenderly.
For this cause I will make her come into the waste land and will say words of comfort to her.
後來我必勸導她，領她到曠野，對她說安慰的話。
There I will give back her vineyards and make the Valley of Achor into a gateway of hope. There she will respond as she did in the days of her youth, as in the day she came up out of Egypt.

And I will give her vine-gardens from there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope; and she will give her answer there as in the days when she was young, and as in the time when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
她從那裡出來，我必賜她葡萄園，又賜她亞割谷作為指望的門。她必在那裡應聲（或譯：歌唱），與幼年的日子一樣，與從埃及地上來的時候相同。
In that day,” declares the LORD, “you will call Me ‘my Husband,’ and no longer call Me ‘my Master.’
And in that day, says the Lord, you will say to me, Ishi; and you will never again give me the name of Baali;
耶和華說：「那日你必稱呼我伊施（就是我夫的意思），不再稱呼我巴力（就是我主的意思）；
For I will remove from her lips the names of the Baals; no longer will their names be invoked.
For I will take away the names of the Baals out of her mouth, and never again will she say their names.
因為我必從我民的口中除掉諸巴力的名號，這名號不再提起。

On that day I will make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field and the birds of the air and the creatures that crawl on the ground. And I will abolish bow and sword and weapons of war in the land, and will make them lie down in safety.

And in that day I will make an agreement for them with the beasts of the field and the birds of heaven and the things which go low on the earth; I will put an end to the bow and the sword and war in all the land, and will make them take their rest in peace.
當那日，我必為我的民，與田野的走獸和空中的飛鳥，並地上的昆蟲立約；又必在國中折斷弓刀，止息爭戰，使他們安然躺臥。
So I will betroth you to Me forever; I will betroth you in righteousness and justice, in loving devotion and compassion.
And I will take you as my bride for ever; truly, I will take you as my bride in righteousness and in right judging, in love and in mercies.
我必聘你永遠歸我為妻，以仁義、公平、慈愛、憐憫聘你歸我；
And I will betroth you in faithfulness, and you will know the LORD.”
I will take you as my bride in good faith, and you will have knowledge of the Lord.
也以誠實聘你歸我，你就必認識我─耶和華。
“On that day I will respond—” declares the LORD— “I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the earth.
And it will be, in that day, says the Lord, that I will give an answer to the heavens, and the heavens to the earth;
耶和華說：那日我必應允，我必應允天，天必應允地；
And the earth will respond to the grain, to the new wine and oil, and they will respond to Jezreel.
And the earth will give its answer to the grain and the wine and the oil, and they will give an answer to Jezreel;
地必應允五穀、新酒，和油，這些必應允耶斯列民（耶斯列就是神栽種的意思）。
And I will sow her as My own in the land, and I will have compassion on ‘No Compassion.’ I will say to those called ‘Not My People,’ ‘You are My people,’ and they will say, ‘You are my God.’”
And I will put her as seed in the earth, and I will have mercy on her to whom no mercy was given; and I will say to those who were not my people, You are my people, and they will say, My God.
我必將她種在這地。素不蒙憐憫的，我必憐憫；本非我民的，我必對他說：你是我的民；他必說：你是我的神。」
